scope_limitations: The attack targets the ordinary CUBE proof verifier and its Sys-EUF-CMA credential endpoint.
The deployed evidence consists of read-only historical simulations at author-listed addresses; no forged mint was broadcast.
The audit does not claim an independent source-to-runtime bytecode match.
The source's separate address-binding omission is not needed for the attack.
Generic BBS nonidentity validation and identity-element reasoning are prior art; no technique novelty is claimed.
The attack-history statement is bounded to public material located through 18 October 2026.
repair_direction: Reject identity-valued proof points before challenge derivation and verification at every boundary while retaining subgroup and canonical-encoding validation; review compatibility and security after a concrete patch.
